    oscillatory_term = numpy.exp(2j * numpy.pi * (frequency * time_axis) + 1j * phase)

    """Averages registered transients, ignoring the ones which do not match.

    median), so it adapts to the noise level of the series instead of assuming
    one, and it is only applied when there are enough transients to make the
